Iron Lung, Steröid, Rhododendron and Parts & Labor added to the line-up

October 23, 2026

It’s been another busy week for Roadburn 2027! Alongside day tickets and two-day tickets going on sale, we’ve added four more names to the line-up: Iron Lung, Steröid, Rhododendron and Parts & Labor.

Four very different acts, each bringing something of their own to the mix – from uncompromising DIY powerviolence to full-throttle rock’n’roll, adventurous experimentation and a glorious burst of creative energy. It’s all part of the picture taking shape for next April, and there’s plenty more to come.

Here’s where we’re at so far

  • Antropoceno (No Ritmo da Terra in full) — Friday
  • Emma Ruth Rundle (These Killing Times in full) — Thursday
  • IAN — Thursday
  • Iron Lung — Thursday
  • Kulk — Saturday
  • Neurosis — Friday and Saturday
  • Parts & Labor — Thursday
  • Rhododendron — Thursday
  • Sadness — Thursday
  • Steröid — Thursday
  • Trhä — Friday
  • Violencia — Thursday

    Already found some new favourites? Or spotted a name you’ve been hoping to see at Roadburn? If you’re curious about any of the artists announced so far, head over to roadburn.com/line-up and dive into Becky Laverty’s always wonderful write-ups. They’re a great place to start exploring what makes each of these artists special.
